newsitem.title: USA: Delta Woodside sees Q4 net below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Delta Woodside sees Q4 net below estimates.

text.p: Delta Woodside Industries Inc said on Wednesday that it expected its fourth fiscal quarter net income to come in close to break-even and lower than analysts' projections.
"Unseasonably cold weather and slow spring retail sales have hurt replenishment business in the company's apparel business," said company president E. Erwin Maddrey.
Maddrey added that the company expected reduced operating schedules in some apparel segment plants to continue through the first quarter of fiscal 1998.
"On the other hand, fiscal 1997 fourth quarter earnings in the textile segment are expected to balance the fourth quarter losses of the apparel and other segments," he said.
Delta Woodside Industries manufactures textile fabrics and apparel.
